card.name: Digits inside 1-800 phone numbers
card.fires_on: The hyphen or digit partway through a toll-free phone number, mostly the Fresenius Kabi number 1-800-551-7176 in drug-label contact lines. It also fires in a few other long digit strings such as an ISBN and an acetaminophen helpline number.

modes.label: Fresenius Kabi phone number
modes.description: The hyphen or digits inside 1-800-551-7176 in adverse-event reporting text.
modes.example: please call Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC at 1-800-551<<->>7176. To report SUS

modes.label: Other helpline numbers
modes.description: Digits inside other 1-800 or extension numbers, such as a poison or acetaminophen helpline.
modes.example: special health professional assistance line for acetaminophen overdose at 1-800-525-61<<1>>5.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit inside an ISBN in a citation.

card.plain: It lights up on the middle of a phone number like 1-800-551-7176 in a label's contact line.
